member.name: T:Fuxion.Analyzers.DiagnosticIds
member.summary: Centralized diagnostic IDs for all Fuxion analyzers. Pattern: FX + [Area Code] + [Number]

member.name: F:Fuxion.Analyzers.DiagnosticIds.RequiresNotNullViolation
member.summary: FX001: Member requiring non-null accessed on nullable type. Cannot access member marked with [RequiresNotNull] on nullable type.

member.name: T:Fuxion.Analyzers.RequiresNotNullAnalyzer
member.summary: Analyzer that detects access to members marked with [RequiresNotNull] on nullable types. Reports diagnostic FX001 when a member requiring non-null is accessed on a nullable type without using the null-conditional operator (?.).

member.name: P:Fuxion.Analyzers.RequiresNotNullAnalyzer.SupportedDiagnostics
member.summary: Gets the set of diagnostic descriptors supported by this analyzer.

member.name: M:Fuxion.Analyzers.RequiresNotNullAnalyzer.Initialize(Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Diagnostics.AnalysisContext)
member.summary: Initializes the analyzer and configures its analysis actions within the specified analysis context.
member.remarks: This method sets up the analyzer to process simple member access expressions and enables concurrent execution. It should be called by the analysis host to begin analysis.
member.param: The analysis context to register actions and configure analyzer behavior. Cannot be null.

member.name: M:Fuxion.Analyzers.RequiresNotNullAnalyzer.AnalyzeFxOrigin(Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.Syntax.ExpressionSyntax,Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.SemanticModel)
member.summary: Analyzes the origin of a .Fx expression to determine if the original value was nullable. For example: "hello".Fx vs nullable?.Fx

member.name: M:Fuxion.Analyzers.RequiresNotNullAnalyzer.HasRequiresNotNullAttribute(Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.ISymbol)
member.summary: Checks if the member has [RequiresNotNull] attribute directly. This works for traditional properties and methods.

member.name: M:Fuxion.Analyzers.RequiresNotNullAnalyzer.HasRequiresNotNullInContainingType(Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.ISymbol)
member.summary: Checks if the containing type has [HasMembersRequiringNotNull] attribute listing this member. This is a workaround for C# 14 extension members where individual member attributes are not visible to analyzers.

member.name: M:Fuxion.Analyzers.RequiresNotNullAnalyzer.HasNullableGenericParameter(Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.ITypeSymbol)
member.summary: Checks if the type has any nullable generic type parameters. For example, List<string?> has a nullable generic parameter.
